hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then REPO="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/matt/Repos/VibrationofAwesome}"; pdfs=$(git -C "$REPO" diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -i '\.pdf$' || true); if [ -n "$pdfs" ]; then full_paths=$(echo "$pdfs" | while IFS= read -r f; do echo "$REPO/$f"; done); bash "$REPO/scripts/scrub-pdf-metadata.sh" $full_paths && echo "$pdfs" | while IFS= read -r f; do git -C "$REPO" add "$f" 2>/dev/null; done; fi; fi
